component.name: Snow Launcher
component.summary: Keeps the official Battle.net app well configured on Linux
Mantém o Battle.net oficial bem configurado no Linux

description.p: A companion for running the official Battle.net app under Wine or Proton. It sets up a dedicated environment for it, installs Battle.net with a verified installer, imports games from other launchers, and watches over your play: no automatic suspend while a game runs, and a warning when a game's connection dies.
Snow Launcher never talks to Blizzard's servers, never touches your credentials and never changes games. It is an independent project, not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.
First test release: the Battle.net house, a GNOME window and a tray icon.
